-- RNGClient: side menu, panels, Index/Inventory cards, equip buttons, settings.
-- Rolling itself lives in RollController.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local ItemIcon = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ItemIcon"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local getInventory = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetInventory")
local equipRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipShovel")

local gui = script.Parent
local menu = gui:WaitForChild("LeftMenu")
local panels = gui:WaitForChild("Panels")
local rollFinished = gui:WaitForChild("RollFinished")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(25, 45, 90)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local MAX_EQUIPPED = Config.MaxEquipped or 2

local counts = {}
local equipped = {}
local refresh -- forward declaration

local function tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function lighten(c, a) return c:Lerp(WHITE, a) end
local function darken(c, a) return c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), a) end

local function bounce(btn)
	local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then return end
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.1}) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.88}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.25, {Scale = 1.1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- PANELS
--------------------------------------------------
local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
blur.Name = "MenuBlur"
blur.Size = 0
blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local openPanel = nil
local function showPanel(p)
	local s = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	p.Visible = true
	s.Scale = 0.5
	tween(s, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end
local function hidePanel(p)
	local s = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 0.5}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In).Completed:Connect(function()
		if openPanel ~= p then p.Visible = false end
	end)
end
local function setBlur(on) tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = on and 16 or 0}) end

local function togglePanel(name)
	local target = panels:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not target then return end
	if openPanel then hidePanel(openPanel) end
	if openPanel == target then
		openPanel = nil
		setBlur(false)
		return
	end
	openPanel = target
	showPanel(target)
	setBlur(true)
end
local function closeAll()
	if openPanel then
		hidePanel(openPanel)
		openPanel = nil
		setBlur(false)
	end
end

-- Frostfall huts use the existing panel state and close behavior.
gui:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu").Event:Connect(function(name)
 if name == "Upgrades" then closeAll(); return end
 if name == "Pets" then name = "Inventory" end
 local target = panels:FindFirstChild(name)
 if target and (name == "Inventory" or name == "Shop" or name == "Rebirth") and openPanel ~= target then togglePanel(name) end
end)

local menuButtons = menu:GetChildren()
local settingsCorner = gui:FindFirstChild("SettingsCorner")
if settingsCorner then
	for _, x in ipairs(settingsCorner:GetChildren()) do table.insert(menuButtons, x) end
	-- phones/tablets have the jump button bottom-right, so put Settings top-right there
	if game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled then
		settingsCorner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		settingsCorner.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 14)
	end
end
for _, b in ipairs(menuButtons) do
	if b:IsA("ImageButton") then
		bounce(b)
		b.Activated:Connect(function() togglePanel(b:GetAttribute("Panel")) end)
	end
end
for _, p in ipairs(panels:GetChildren()) do
	local c = p:FindFirstChild("Close")
	if c then
		bounce(c)
		c.Activated:Connect(closeAll)
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- EQUIPPING
--------------------------------------------------
local function copiesEquipped(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function sendEquip(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		equipped = res
		refresh()
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CARDS
--------------------------------------------------
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end
local function smallButton(parent, props, color, text)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = color}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do b[k] = v end
	round(b, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
	local s = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, b)
	label(b, text, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.72)}, 2)
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.08}) end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.9}) end)
	return b
end

local function card(parent, order, item, count, locked, mode)
	local color = locked and Color3.fromRGB(165, 172, 190) or (Config.Rarities[item.Rarity] or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190))

	local holder = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, nil)
	local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, holder)
	local shadow = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(shadow, 0.16)

	local main = mk("Frame", {Name = "Main", BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(lighten(color, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)
	local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, Color = darken(color, 0.45), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, main)

	if locked then
		label(main, "?", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.43)}, 3)
	else
		local iconBox = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.43)}, main)
		ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = iconBox
	end
	label(main, locked and "???" or item.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.19)}, 2.5)
	if item.Mutation and not locked and mode == "inventory" then -- Index tabs already say which version
		local rib = mk("Frame", {Name = "MutationRibbon", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.03),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.13), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 4}, holder)
		round(rib, 1)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, rib)
		local seq = item.Mutation == "Shiny Giant" and ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 120)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 70)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.66, Color3.fromRGB(110, 225, 130)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(110, 150, 255))})
			or item.Mutation == "Shiny" and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 130), Color3.fromRGB(238, 160, 25))
			or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 255))
		mk("UIGradient", {Color = seq}, rib)
		local t = label(rib, string.upper(item.Mutation), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.1), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.8), ZIndex = 5}, 2)
	end

	if mode == "inventory" then
		local on = copiesEquipped(item.Name)
		local canAdd = on < count
		local eb = smallButton(main, {Name = "EquipButton", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.73),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.18)}, canAdd and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90),
			canAdd and "EQUIP" or "EQUIPPED")
		eb.Activated:Connect(function()
			if canAdd then sendEquip("equip", item.Name) end
		end)
		if on > 0 then
			stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 90)
			stroke.Thickness = 6
			local x = smallButton(holder, {Name = "UnequipButton", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.07),
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26)}, Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80), "X")
			mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, x)
			x.Activated:Connect(function() sendEquip("unequip", item.Name) end)
			if on > 1 then
				label(main, "ON x" .. on, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.36), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.12),
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 130)}, 2.5)
			end
		end
	else
		local pill = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = OUTLINE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.74), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.16)}, main)
		round(pill, 1)
		label(pill, "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.72),
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 110)}, false)
	end

	if not locked and item.Chance >= 10 then
		local shine = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Active = false}, main)
		round(shine, 0.16)
		local g = mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 25, Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0), Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.45),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})}, shine)
		TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.In, -1, false, 1),
			{Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)}):Play()
	end

	if count and count > 0 then
		local badge = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.17)}, holder)
		round(badge, 1)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, badge)
		label(badge, "x" .. count, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.76), TextColor3 = OUTLINE}, false)
	end

	main.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.15, {Scale = 1.04}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	main.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.15, {Scale = 1}) end)
	holder.Parent = parent
end

local function clear(sc)
	for _, c in ipairs(sc:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- INDEX CATEGORIES (2026-10-02): Normal / Giant / Shiny / Shiny Giant tabs.
-- Each tab lists all 35 shovels in that version (Config.VariantsOf slots 1/2/3); the Inventory still shows everything owned.
--------------------------------------------------
local INDEX_CATS = {
	{Id = "Normal", Title = "INDEX", Tab = "NormalTab", Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255)},
	{Id = "Giant", Title = "GIANT", Tab = "GiantTab", Slot = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255)},
	{Id = "Shiny", Title = "SHINY", Tab = "ShinyTab", Slot = 2, Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 180, 40)},
	{Id = "Shiny Giant", Title = "SHINY GIANT", Tab = "ShinyGiantTab", Slot = 3, Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 110, 255)},
}
local TAB_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
local indexCat = INDEX_CATS[1]
local indexTabs = panels.Index.Inner:FindFirstChild("TabBar")
local function styleIndexTabs()
	if not indexTabs then return end
	for _, c in ipairs(INDEX_CATS) do
		local b = indexTabs:FindFirstChild(c.Tab)
		if b then b.BackgroundColor3 = (c == indexCat) and c.Color or TAB_OFF end
	end
end
if indexTabs then
	for _, c in ipairs(INDEX_CATS) do
		local b = indexTabs:FindFirstChild(c.Tab)
		if b then
			b.Activated:Connect(function()
				if indexCat == c then return end
				indexCat = c
				styleIndexTabs()
				panels.Index.Inner.Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
				refresh()
			end)
		end
	end
	styleIndexTabs()
end

refresh = function()
	local idx = panels.Index.Inner.Content
	local inv = panels.Inventory.Inner.Content
	clear(idx); clear(inv)
	local owned, invCards, catOwned = 0, 0, 0
	for i, item in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		local n = counts[item.Name] or 0
		if n > 0 then
			owned += 1
			invCards += 1
			card(inv, i * 10, item, n, false, "inventory")
		end
		-- the Index shows this shovel in the selected version (Normal / Giant / Shiny / Shiny Giant)
		local shown = item
		if indexCat.Slot and Config.VariantsOf and Config.VariantsOf[item.Name] then shown = Config.VariantsOf[item.Name][indexCat.Slot] or item end
		local sn = counts[shown.Name] or 0
		if sn > 0 then catOwned += 1 end
		card(idx, i * 10, shown, sn, sn == 0, "index")
		-- mutated versions you own (Giant / Shiny / Shiny Giant) sit right after their shovel in the Inventory
		for k, v in ipairs(Config.VariantsOf and Config.VariantsOf[item.Name] or {}) do
			local vn = counts[v.Name] or 0
			if vn > 0 then
				invCards += 1
				card(inv, i * 10 + k, v, vn, false, "inventory")
			end
		end
	end
	if invCards == 0 then
		label(inv, "Roll to find your first shovel! ❄", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)}, 3)
	end
	panels.Index.Banner.Title.Text = ("%s %d/%d"):format(indexCat.Title, catOwned, #Config.Items)
	if panels.Inventory:GetAttribute("Tab") ~= "Pets" then panels.Inventory.Banner.Title.Text = ("INVENTORY %d/%d"):format(#equipped, game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or MAX_EQUIPPED) end
end

rollFinished.Event:Connect(function(_, newCounts, newEquipped)
	if newCounts then counts = newCounts end
	equipped = {}
	for name in (game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(equipped, name) end
	refresh()
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS (shared with RollController via attribute)
--------------------------------------------------
gui:SetAttribute("FastRolls", false)
local tog = panels.Settings.Inner.Content.SkipRow.SkipAnim
local knob = tog.Knob
tog.Activated:Connect(function()
	local on = not gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	gui:SetAttribute("FastRolls", on)
	tween(knob, 0.2, {Position = on and UDim2.fromScale(0.54, 0.5) or UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.5)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	tween(tog, 0.2, {BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 110) or Color3.fromRGB(190, 196, 212)})
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOAD SAVED DATA
--------------------------------------------------
refresh()
task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return getInventory:InvokeServer() end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then
			counts = res.Counts or {}
			equipped = res.Equipped or {}
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	refresh()
end)

-- admin commands changed our shovels: reload
ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DataRefresh").OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return getInventory:InvokeServer() end)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		counts = res.Counts or {}
		equipped = res.Equipped or {}
		refresh()
	end
end)


-- A rebirth may reduce slots while an earlier roll animation is finishing.
game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedShovels"):Connect(function()
 equipped = {}
 for name in (game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(equipped, name) end
 refresh()
end)

-- PetClient: PETS tab in the inventory + egg hatch animation.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local PetModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetModels"))
local EggModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggModels"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local hatchedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetHatched")
local equipRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipPet")
local getPets = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetPets")

local gui = script.Parent
local panel = gui:WaitForChild("Panels"):WaitForChild("Inventory")
local inner = panel:WaitForChild("Inner")
local shovelContent = inner:WaitForChild("Content")
local petContent = inner:WaitForChild("PetContent")
local tabBar = inner:WaitForChild("TabBar")
local title = panel:WaitForChild("Banner"):WaitForChild("Title")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(25, 45, 90)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local MAX = PetConfig.MaxEquipped

local pets, equipped, discovered = {}, {}, {}
local updateSigns = function() end
local tab = "Shovels"
local refresh

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- 3D pet preview inside a frame
local function viewport(parent, petName, props)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
		LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do vp[k] = v end
	local m = PetModels.create(petName)
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	m.Parent = vp
	local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 1.7 + 1.5
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(dist * 0.45, dist * 0.25, -dist), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	vp.Parent = parent
	return vp, m
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- TABS
--------------------------------------------------
local function setTab(t)
	tab = t
	panel:SetAttribute("Tab", t)
	shovelContent.Visible = t == "Shovels"
	petContent.Visible = t == "Pets"
	for _, b in ipairs(tabBar:GetChildren()) do
		if b:IsA("TextButton") then
			b.BackgroundColor3 = (b.Name == t .. "Tab") and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
		end
	end
	if t == "Pets" then refresh() else
		-- let RNGClient's title come back
		local n = 0
		for _ in (Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do n += 1 end
		title.Text = ("INVENTORY %d/%d"):format(n, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or 2)
	end
end
tabBar:WaitForChild("ShovelsTab").Activated:Connect(function() setTab("Shovels") end)
tabBar:WaitForChild("PetsTab").Activated:Connect(function() setTab("Pets") end)
gui:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu").Event:Connect(function(name)
 if name == "Pets" then setTab("Pets") end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PET CARDS
--------------------------------------------------
local function copies(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function send(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then equipped = res; refresh() end
end

local function smallButton(parent, props, color, text)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = color}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do b[k] = v end
	round(b, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
	label(b, text, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.72)}, 2)
	return b
end

local function card(order, pet, count)
	local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local holder = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, nil)
	local shadow = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(shadow, 0.16)
	local main = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)
	local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, main)
	viewport(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.02), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.44)})
	label(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.46), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.14)}, 2.5)
	label(main, "+" .. math.floor(pet.Boost * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.11),

local function eggArt(eggId)
	local display = workspace:FindFirstChild("EggDisplay", true)
	local src = display and display:FindFirstChild(eggId)
	if not (src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")) then
		-- World 2 eggs (2026-10-02, Claude) stand in their own stages, not in the lobby EggDisplay
		for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == eggId and d:FindFirstChild("Shell") then src = d; break end
		end
	end
	local shell = src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shell and shell:IsA("MeshPart") then
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = eggId
		local c = shell:Clone()
		c.Anchored = true
		c.PivotOffset = CFrame.new() -- imported meshes carry a 90-degree pivot; keep the egg upright
		c.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		c.Parent = m
		m.PrimaryPart = c
		-- World 2 eggs: decoration parts tagged EggArt (petals, bands...) follow the shell
		for _, d in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("EggArt") then
				local e = d:Clone()
				e.Anchored = true
				e.CFrame = shell.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(d.CFrame)
				e.Parent = m
			end
		end
		return m
	end
	return EggModels.create(eggId)
end

local function playHatch(eggId, petName, isNew)

	for _, c in ipairs(stage:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end end

	overlay.Visible = true

	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.15, -math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = eggVp
	eggVp.CurrentCamera = cam
	topText.Text = "Hatching..."

	-- shake harder and harder
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.6 do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 1.6
		eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (0.08 + k * 0.28)))
		task.wait()
	end

	tween(flash, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	eggVp:Destroy()
	local pet = PetConfig.PetByName[petName]

	subText.TextColor3 = WHITE

	local t1 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t1 < 2.4 do
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, (os.clock() - t1) * 1.5, 0))
		task.wait()
	end
	tween(overlay, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(0.3)
	popScale:Destroy()
	vp:Destroy()
	overlay.Visible = false
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	playing = false
end

local SHOW_DISTANCE = 25
local HIDE_DISTANCE = 30
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		-- eggs stand close together in the lobby row: only the nearest egg's sign may show
		local nearest, nearestDist = nil, math.huge
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent and hrp then
				local d = (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude
				if d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = entry, d end
			end
		end
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
				local dist = hrp and (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
				if entry ~= nearest then dist = math.huge end
				if not entry.shown and dist < SHOW_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = true
					entry.bb.Enabled = true
					entry.scale.Scale = 0
					tween(entry.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				elseif entry.shown and dist > HIDE_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = false
					local tw = tween(entry.scale, 0.2, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					tw.Completed:Connect(function()
						if not entry.shown then entry.bb.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)

local function fitTo(v, animated)

	local minX, maxX, minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(points) do
		minX = math.min(minX, p.X); maxX = math.max(maxX, p.X); minY = math.min(minY, p.Y); maxY = math.max(maxY, p.Y)
	end
	local viewSize = bg.AbsoluteSize
	if viewSize.X < 10 then viewSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize end
	local w, h = (maxX - minX) + R * 2.6, (maxY - minY) + R * 2.8
	local s = math.clamp(math.min(viewSize.X * 0.84 / w, viewSize.Y * 0.62 / h), math.clamp(viewSize.X / 1450, 0.6, 0.95), 1.15)
	local cx, cy = (minX + maxX) / 2, (minY + maxY) / 2
	local target = UDim2.new(0.5, -cx * s, 0.56, -cy * s)
	if animated then
		tween(b.frame, 0.5, {Position = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		tween(b.scale, 0.5, {Scale = s}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
	else

	end
end

refresh = function(animate)
	local owned, stages, money = ownedSet(), stageSet(), snow()
	local states, done = {}, 0
	local snowStart = owned["S_Center"] == true
	for id in pairs(owned) do states[id] = "owned"; done += 1 end
	local frontier = {}
	for id, n in pairs(U.ById) do
		if not owned[id] then
			local front
			if id == "R_Luck1" then front = snowStart          -- the branch: Lucky Start opens once Snow Start is owned
			elseif n.Center then front = true                  -- Snow Start, Misc Start
			else
				for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if owned[nb.Id] then front = true; break end end
			end
			if front then table.insert(frontier, n) end
		end
	end
	local lockText, miscGreen = {}, 0
	for _, n in ipairs(frontier) do
		local reason = U.LockReason(n, owned, stages)
		if n.Id == "R_Luck1" and reason ~= nil and not n.RequiredStage then reason = nil end
		if reason == nil and money >= U.CostOf(n) then
			states[n.Id] = "buy"
			if n.Tree == "Misc" then miscGreen += 1 end
		else
			states[n.Id] = "cant"
			if reason then
				local st = StageConfig.ById and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage]
				lockText[n.Id] = "Unlock " .. ((st and st.Name) or n.RequiredStage or "the next area") .. " first"
			end
		end
	end
	for _, n in ipairs(frontier) do
		for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if not states[nb.Id] then states[nb.Id] = "mystery" end end
	end

	progressLabel.Text = done .. " / " .. TOTAL .. " owned"
	table.clear(pulsing)
	for id, t in pairs(tiles) do
		local st = states[id] or "hidden"
		local prev = t.state
		t.state = st
		if st == "hidden" then
			t.holder.Visible = false
		else
			local n = t.node
			local hasIcon = (n.Icon or "") ~= ""
			t.lock = lockText[id]
			if st == "owned" then
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, n.Text, Color3.fromRGB(205, 230, 255), hasIcon)
			elseif st == "buy" then
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n)), WHITE, hasIcon)
				table.insert(pulsing, t)
			elseif st == "cant" then
				local stg = StageConfig.ById and n.RequiredStage and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage]
				local sub = t.lock and ("🔒 " .. ((stg and stg.Name) or n.RequiredStage or "")) or ("❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n)))
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, sub, Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 120), hasIcon)
				table.insert(pulsing, t)
			else
				setLook(t, st, "", "", WHITE, false)
			end
			t.holder.Visible = true
			if animate and prev == "hidden" then
				t.scale.Scale = 0.15
				tween(t.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			end
		end
	end
	-- stone path + MISC link grow out of Snow Start (also shown if older saves already own Rolls/Misc tiles)
	local anyRolls, anyMisc, miscOwned = false, false, 0
	for id in pairs(owned) do
		local n = U.ById[id]
		if n and n.Tree == "Rolls" then anyRolls = true end
		if n and n.Tree == "Misc" then anyMisc = true; miscOwned += 1 end
	end
	local showPath = snowStart or anyRolls
	for i, p in ipairs(pathTiles) do
		if showPath and not p.shown then
			p.shown = true
			p.holder.Visible = true
			if animate then
				p.scale.Scale = 0.1
				task.delay(i * 0.08, function() tween(p.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
			end
		elseif not showPath then
			p.shown = false
			p.holder.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local showMisc = snowStart or anyMisc
	local wasHidden = not miscLink.holder.Visible
	miscLink.holder.Visible = showMisc
	if showMisc and wasHidden and animate then
		miscLink.scale.Scale = 0.15
		tween(miscLink.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end
	miscLink.sub.Text = miscOwned .. "/" .. #U.TreeById.Misc.Nodes
	miscLink.sub.Visible = true
	miscLink.badge.Visible = miscGreen > 0
	miscLink.badgeLabel.Text = tostring(miscGreen)
	backLink.holder.Visible = view == "Misc"
	if hovered then showTip(hovered) end
end

local pulseConn
local function startPulse()
	if pulseConn then return end
	pulseConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, t in ipairs(pulsing) do
			local st = STYLE[t.state]
			if st and st.glow then
				local a = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * (t.state == "buy" and 5.5 or 4) + t.phase)
				local g = GLOWBASE:Lerp(st.glow, 0.25 + 0.65 * a)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.glowRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = g end
				local c = st.fill:Lerp(WHITE, 0.22 * a)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.fillRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = c end
				local s2 = c:Lerp(WHITE, 1 - st.shine)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.shineRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = s2 end
			end
		end
		for _, l in pairs(links) do
			local a = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 2.2 + l.phase)
			local g = GLOWBASE:Lerp(STYLE.link.glow, 0.3 + 0.5 * a)
			for _, r in ipairs(l.glowRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = g end
			if l.badge.Visible then l.badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34 + 4 * a, 34 + 4 * a) end
		end
	end)
end
local function stopPulse()
	if pulseConn then pulseConn:Disconnect(); pulseConn = nil end
end

local weightTotal = 0
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do weightTotal += 1 / it.Chance end
local function randomItem()
	local n = math.random() * weightTotal
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		n -= 1 / it.Chance
		if n <= 0 then return it end
	end
	return Config.Items[1]
end
local function itemAt(j)
	if not seq[j] then seq[j] = randomItem() end
	return seq[j]
end

local function setItem(s, item)
	s.item = item
	s.odds.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	s.name.Text = string.upper(item.Name)
	s.holder:ClearAllChildren()
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = s.holder

local posValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
posValue.Value = 0
local lastPos, speed = 0, 0

local function render()
	local pos = posValue.Value
	local base = math.floor(pos + 0.5)
	local range = mode.range
	local used = {}
	local motion = math.clamp(speed / 35, 0, 1)
	for j = base - range, base + range do
		local s = slots[(j % NSLOTS) + 1]
		used[s] = true
		local item = itemAt(j)
		if s.item ~= item then setItem(s, item) end
		local d = j - pos
		local ad = math.abs(d)
		s.cg.Visible = true
		s.cg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot)
		s.cg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + d * mode.slot)
		-- fade + darken with distance, extra transparency when moving fast (motion blur feel)
		local fade = math.clamp(ad / (range + 0.5), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(fade * 0.92 + motion * (ad < 0.5 and 0.25 or 0.45), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(FADED, math.clamp(ad * 1.2, 0, 1))
		s.scale.Scale = (1 - math.min(ad, 2) * 0.17) * s.pop
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
		if not used[s] then s.cg.Visible = false end
	end
end

local function doRoll()
	if rolling or gui:GetAttribute("RebirthMenuOpen") or game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return end
	rolling = true
	rollId += 1
	local myId = rollId

	local animScale = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1
	local gap = (Config.RollCooldown * animScale + 0.1) - (os.clock() - lastFire)
	if gap > 0 then task.wait(gap) end

	local result, counts, equipped, luck
	waiting = function(r, c, e, l) result, counts, equipped, luck = r, c, e, l end
	lastFire = os.clock()
	remote:FireServer()

	showStage()
	tween(rays, 0.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.55})
	tween(glowScale, 0.2, {Scale = 1})

	-- creep the reel while the server answers
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while result == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
		posValue.Value += 0.15
		task.wait()
	end
	waiting = nil
	if not result then
		rolling = false
		hideStage()
		return
	end

	local fast = gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	local base = math.floor(posValue.Value + 0.5)
	local dist = fast and 8 or (26 + math.random(0, 6))
	local target = base + dist
	for j = base + 1, target + 4 do seq[j] = randomItem() end
	seq[target] = Config.ByName[result] or Config.Items[1]
	for j in pairs(seq) do
		if j < base - 10 then seq[j] = nil end -- keep memory tiny
	end

	-- decelerate, overshoot a touch, settle back onto the winner
	local wonItem = Config.ByName[result]
	local hadRareCutscene = Cutscene.ShouldPlay(wonItem, luck)
	if hadRareCutscene then
		-- RARE: reel starts, then the screen cuts to black for the cutscene
		local tw = tween(posValue, 3.1, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		task.wait(0.9)
		Cutscene.Play(wonItem, luck)
		tw:Cancel()
		posValue.Value = target
	else
		tween(posValue, fast and 0.7 or 3.1 * animScale, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint).Completed:Wait()
		tween(posValue, 0.35, {Value = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	end

	if not hadRareCutscene then playLandingTick() end

	-- winner!
	local win = slots[(target % NSLOTS) + 1]
	local popV = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	popV.Value = 1.3
	popV.Changed:Connect(function(v) win.pop = v end)
	win.pop = 1.3
	tween(popV, 0.4, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function() popV:Destroy(); win.pop = 1 end)
	glowScale.Scale = 1.5
	tween(glowScale, 0.5, {Scale = 1.2}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0
	tween(rays, 1.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.3})
	if (Config.ByName[result] and Config.ByName[result].Chance or 0) >= Config.BigRollAt then
		task.spawn(fovPunch)
	end

	rollFinished:Fire(result, counts, equipped)
	rolling = false

	task.delay(1.8, function()
		if rollId == myId and not rolling then hideStage() end
	end)
end

-- cached Sound per id (so we know each file's real length for timing)
local cache = {}
local function soundFor(def)
	if not def or not def.Id or def.Id == "" then return nil end
	local s = cache[def.Id]
	if not s then
		s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.SoundId = def.Id
		s.Parent = sg
		cache[def.Id] = s
	end
	return s
end
local function lengthOf(def, fallback)
	local s = soundFor(def)
	if s and s.IsLoaded and s.TimeLength > 0 then return s.TimeLength / (def.Speed or 1) end
	return fallback or 0.8
end
local function playDef(def, volMul)
	local s = soundFor(def)
	if not s then return end
	s.PlaybackSpeed = def.Speed or 1
	s.Volume = (def.Volume or 1) * (volMul or 1)
	s.TimePosition = 0
	s:Play()
end
local function play(key, volMul) playDef(Config.RareDrop.Sounds[key], volMul) end

	if playing or not item then return end
	playing = true
	luck = math.max(luck or 1, 1)
	local S = Config.RareDrop.Sounds
	local itemTier = TIER[item.Rarity] or tierForChance(item.Chance)
	-- start the climb at the tier that is "rare for you" (higher luck = starts higher)
	local startTier = math.min(itemTier, tierForChance(Config.RareDrop.Threshold * luck))
	local steps = itemTier - startTier + 1
	local finalColor = Config.Rarities[ORDER[itemTier]] or WHITE

	player:SetAttribute("MusicDuck", true)
	sg.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	sg.Enabled = true
	blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK

	-- 1) black + start sound; the first step lands when the start sound ends
	play("Start")
	tween(bg, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 30})
	task.wait(lengthOf(S.Start, 1.1))

	-- 2) the climb: each step lasts exactly as long as its own sound
	tierLabel.TextTransparency = 0
	tierStroke.Transparency = 0
	for k = 0, steps - 1 do
		local name = ORDER[startTier + k]
		local color = Config.Rarities[name] or WHITE
		local power = (k + 1) / steps
		local def = stepDef(name)
		local last = (k == steps - 1)
		playDef(def, 0.85 + power * 0.3)
		tierLabel.Text = name:upper()
		tierLabel.TextColor3 = color
		tierScale.Scale = 2.6 + power
		tween(tierScale, 0.35, {Scale = 1 + power * 0.35}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(color, 0.1 + 0.12 * power)
		tween(bg, 0.5, {BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(color, 0.05 + 0.06 * power)})
		shake(0.2 + power * 0.9, 0.4 + power * 0.2)
		shockwave(color, 0.6 + power * 0.9)
		local len = lengthOf(def, 0.85)
		if last then
			-- odds tease appears during the last step; the flash hits when its sound ends
			local tease = math.min(0.35, len * 0.4)
			task.wait(tease)
			oddsLabel.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
			tween(oddsLabel, 0.25, {TextTransparency = 0})
			tween(oddsStroke, 0.25, {Transparency = 0})
			task.wait(len - tease)
		else
			task.wait(len)
		end
	end

	-- 3) white flash + reveal sound + shovel
	play("Reveal")
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tierLabel.TextTransparency = 1; tierStroke.Transparency = 1
	oddsLabel.TextTransparency = 1; oddsStroke.Transparency = 1
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(finalColor, 0.18)
	for _, c in ipairs(iconHolder:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = iconHolder
	iconHolder.Visible = true
	iconScale.Scale = 0.2
	raysTint.Color = ColorSequence.new(finalColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3))
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0.15
	nameLabel.Text = item.Name:upper()
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = WHITE
	subLabel.Text = ORDER[itemTier]:upper() .. "  •  1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	subLabel.TextColor3 = finalColor
	tween(flash, 0.9, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(iconScale, 0.55, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	for _, o in ipairs({nameLabel, subLabel}) do tween(o, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0}) end
	for _, o in ipairs({nameStroke, subStroke}) do tween(o, 0.4, {Transparency = 0}) end
	shake(1.4, 0.6)
	shockwave(finalColor, 2)

	-- hold: at least the whole reveal sound, longer for rarer tiers
	local hold = math.max(lengthOf(S.Reveal, 1.5) + 0.4, 2.2 + itemTier * 0.35)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < hold do
		local t = os.clock() - t0
		rays.Rotation = t * 25
		iconHolder.Rotation = math.sin(t * 2) * 4
		task.wait()
	end

	-- 4) out: the fade lasts as long as the end sound
	play("End")
	local out = math.max(lengthOf(S.End, 0.9), 0.35)
	for _, o in ipairs({nameLabel, subLabel}) do tween(o, out * 0.6, {TextTransparency = 1}) end
	for _, o in ipairs({nameStroke, subStroke}) do tween(o, out * 0.6, {Transparency = 1}) end
	tween(rays, out * 0.6, {GroupTransparency = 1})
	tween(iconScale, out * 0.6, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
	tween(bg, out, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, out, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(out)
	iconHolder.Visible = false
	sg.Enabled = false
	player:SetAttribute("MusicDuck", false)
	playing = false
end

local function ringBurst(pos, color, diameter, count, delay)
	task.delay(delay or 0, function()
		local beads = {}
		for i = 1, count do beads[i] = fxPart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.28), Color = color or hue(0, i / count)}) end
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while true do
			local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / 0.65, 0, 1)
			local r = 0.6 + (diameter / 2 - 0.6) * (1 - (1 - a) ^ 3)
			for i, b in ipairs(beads) do
				local ang = i / count * math.pi * 2
				b.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * r, 0.3, math.sin(ang) * r))
				b.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.9 * a
			end
			if a >= 1 then break end
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(beads) do b:Destroy() end
	end)
end

	local red = reduced()
	local colorSeq = st.Rainbow and RAINBOW or ColorSequence.new(rar.Color, WHITE)
	-- 1) a short puff of snow + rarity sparkles
	burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), SMOKE, ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(245, 250, 255)), red and 5 or 10, 1.0, 9, 0.6, 18)
	if not red then burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0), SPARKLE, colorSeq, st.Sparks, 0.45, 9, 0.9, 6) end

	-- 2) the treasure picture pops out, flips and hovers on a rarity glow (billboard, always faces the camera)
	local holder = fxPart({Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)})
	local bb = mk("BillboardGui", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1), LightInfluence = 0, MaxDistance = 220, ResetOnSpawn = false}, holder)

	local iconBox = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2}, bb)

	if (st.Rays or st.Stars) and not red then ringBurst(pos, (not st.Rainbow) and rar.Color or nil, st.Ring * 1.35, st.Beads, 0.28) end
	local extras = {}

		for i = 1, 6 do extras[#extras + 1] = {ray = true, i = i, p = fxPart({Size = Vector3.new(0.16, 2.8, 0.16), Transparency = 0.4,
			Color = st.Rainbow and hue(0, i / 6) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90)})} end
	end
	if st.Stars and not red then
		for i = 1, 4 do extras[#extras + 1] = {i = i, p = fxPart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4),
			Color = st.Rainbow and hue(0, i / 4) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 200)})} end
	end
	playSound(item.Rarity)
	local BASE = 3.4 -- studs
	local start, top = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), pos + Vector3.new(0, 5.2, 0) -- hovers above head height so the player never hides it
	local hover = red and math.min(st.Hover, 0.35) or st.Hover
	local t0, finished = os.clock(), false
	local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = os.clock() - t0
		local center, size, flip, tilt = top, BASE, 1, 0
		if t < st.Rise then
			local a = t / st.Rise
			local e = TweenService:GetValue(a, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			center = start:Lerp(top, e)
			size = BASE * math.clamp(e, 0.05, 1.15)
			flip = math.abs(math.cos(a * math.pi * 2)) -- two quick flips while it pops out
		elseif t < st.Rise + hover then
			local h = t - st.Rise
			center = top + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(h * 4) * 0.16, 0)
			tilt = math.sin(h * 3) * 6
		else
			-- 4) it flies to the player and shrinks into the reward toast

			local e = TweenService:GetValue(a, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			local target = (root.Parent and root.Position or top) + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			center = top:Lerp(target, e)
			size = BASE * (1 - 0.85 * e)
			if a >= 1 then finished = true end
		end
		holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
		bb.Size = UDim2.new(size, 0, size, 0)
		iconBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(flip, 0.06), 1)
		iconBox.Rotation = tilt
		if glowGrad then glowGrad.Rotation = (t * 90) % 360 end
		local leaving = t > st.Rise + hover
		for _, x in ipairs(extras) do
			if leaving then
				x.p.Transparency = 1
			elseif x.ray then
				x.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, x.i / 6 * math.pi * 2 + t * 0.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(62), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 1.9, 0)
				x.p.Transparency = 0.4 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 3 + x.i)
			else
				local b = t * 2.4 + x.i / 4 * math.pi * 2
				x.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(b) * 2.1, 0.25 + math.sin(t * 3 + x.i) * 0.3, math.sin(b) * 2.1))
			end
		end
	end)
	local deadline = os.clock() + st.Rise + hover + st.Fly + 2
	while not finished and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait() end
	conn:Disconnect()
	for _, x in ipairs(extras) do x.p:Destroy() end
	holder:Destroy()
	if root.Parent then burst(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), SPARKLE, colorSeq, red and 3 or 8, 0.3, 4, 0.5, 0) end
end

	tween(label, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})
	task.wait(0.3)

local function run()
	if running then return end
	running = true
	cancelled = false
	-- Wait for startup too: IntroPlaying is still nil while the avatar loads.
	local intro = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("SnowIntro")
	if intro and intro.Enabled then
		if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroReady") == true end) then return end
	end
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	task.wait(1)
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	sg.Enabled = true

	local bottom = rngGui:WaitForChild("BottomBar")
	local rollB = bottom:WaitForChild("RollButton")
	local upB = bottom:WaitForChild("UpgradesButton")

	-- 1) roll
	say("Your "..(player:GetAttribute("StarterShovelName") or "Tin Shovel").." is ready!\nTap the dice to roll another shovel!")
	pointAt(rollB)
	local rolled = false
	local conn = rngGui:WaitForChild("RollFinished").Event:Connect(function() rolled = true end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return rolled end) then conn:Disconnect() return end
	conn:Disconnect()

	-- 2) the spinner
	pointAt(nil)
	say("Nice! Your shovel spins around you ❄")
	task.wait(2.8)
	if cancelled then return end

	-- 3) dig in the snow field
	local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
	local field
	for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do if f.Id == "FrostfallSnowYard" then field = f break end end
	if not field then
		for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do if f.Id == "Starter" or f.Style == "Starter" then field = f break end end
	end
	local snow = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Snow")
	local start = snow.Value
	local GOAL = 10
	if field then pointWorld(field.Center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end
	local function progress() return math.clamp(snow.Value - start, 0, GOAL) end
	say("Walk into the snow to dig!  0/" .. GOAL .. " ❄")
	local c2 = snow.Changed:Connect(function()
		label.Text = "Walk into the snow to dig!  " .. progress() .. "/" .. GOAL .. " ❄"
	end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return progress() >= GOAL end) then c2:Disconnect() return end
	c2:Disconnect()
	pointWorld(nil)

	-- 4) upgrades
	say("Great! Spend snow on upgrades!")
	pointAt(upB)
	local tree = pg:WaitForChild("UpgradeTreeGui", 30)
	if not waitUntil(function() return tree and tree.Enabled end) then return end
	pointAt(nil)

	-- 5) done
	say("Roll rarer shovels and unlock new areas.\nHave fun!")
	task.wait(3.2)
	finish()
end

-- Smooth (Catmull-Rom) interpolation through {time,value} keys.
local function curve(k,t)
 local n=#k
 if t<=k[1][1]then return k[1][2]end
 if t>=k[n][1]then return k[n][2]end
 local i=1
 while k[i+1][1]<t do i+=1 end
 local a,b=k[i],k[i+1]
 local p,q=k[i-1] or a,k[i+2] or b
 local dt=b[1]-a[1]
 local u=(t-a[1])/dt
 local m0=(b[2]-p[2])/(b[1]-p[1])*dt
 local m1=(q[2]-a[2])/(q[1]-a[1])*dt
 local u2,u3=u*u,u*u*u
 return (2*u3-3*u2+1)*a[2]+(u3-2*u2+u)*m0+(-2*u3+3*u2)*b[2]+(u3-u2)*m1
end

   return V(mix(1,-2.6,e),ay+mix(5.5,2.2,e),mix(19,9.5,e)),V(-3.3,ay+mix(-7,-.8,e),0),mix(70,60,e),rad(3)*math.sin(u*math.pi)
  elseif t<3 then                                      -- 2 SNOW LANDING: low ground-level shot

   return V(mix(-1.6,-2.4,e),mix(.6,1,e),mix(5.8,5,e)),V(-3.1,mix(.4,1.6,smooth(t,2,2.7)),0),mix(50,46,e)
  elseif t<3.75 then                                   -- 3a SHOVEL DISCOVERY: push toward the planted shovel
   local u=ease(span(t,3,3.75))
   return V(mix(6.2,6,u),mix(1.4,2,u),mix(11.5,8.6,u)),V(mix(5,5.1,u),mix(2.6,3.2,u),SHOVEL_AT.Z),mix(46,40,u)
  elseif t<4.2 then                                    -- 3b the avatar notices it
   local u=ease(span(t,3.75,4.2))
   return V(mix(-.4,-1.2,u),mix(2.3,2.6,u),mix(8.6,7.8,u)),V(-3.3,mix(2,3.4,smooth(t,4,4.2)),0),mix(44,42,u)
  elseif t<5.35 then                                   -- 4 GRAB: follow the run, frame hands and shovel
   local g=ease(span(t,4.5,4.9))
   return V(mix(3,6.4,g),mix(2.2,2.6,g),mix(9.5,8.2,g)),V(mix(1,4.6,g),mix(2.4,3.1,g),mix(0,-.3,g)),mix(46,42,g)
  elseif t<6.2 then                                    -- 5 VICTORY: low hero angle, short arc
   local u=ease(span(t,5.35,6.2));local a=rad(mix(-24,20,u));local R=mix(8.6,8,u)

 local function shake(t)

 ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame
 local lastScale,lastMound,lastNest=SCALE,-1,-1
 local function render(t)
  local P,Fr,S,mid=skeleton(t)
  -- shovel, then both hands reach the two grip points on it
  local scf,Ht,Hb,sc=shovelState(t,Fr,mid)
  local w=smooth(t,4.55,4.78)*(1-smooth(t,T_OUT,T_OUT+.3))
  if w>.001 then
   local fwd=WV(Fr.LookVector)
   local pr=rig:reach(S,"Right",W(Ht),{weight=w,pole=WV(Fr:VectorToWorldSpace(V(.7,-.6,.4))),forward=fwd})
   local pl=rig:reach(S,"Left",W(Hb),{weight=w,pole=WV(Fr:VectorToWorldSpace(V(-.7,-.6,.4))),forward=fwd})
   stats.errR=pr and (pr-W(Ht)).Magnitude or 0
   stats.errL=pl and (pl-W(Hb)).Magnitude or 0
  else stats.errR,stats.errL=0,0 end
  rig:commit(S)
  shovel:PivotTo(G*scf)
  if math.abs(sc-lastScale)>.004 then shovel:ScaleTo(sc);lastScale=sc end
  stats.tilt=math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(scf.UpVector.Y,-1,1)))
  -- fall props
  local fallVis=t<T_IMPACT+.05
  if fallVis then
   for _,s in ipairs(streaks)do s.Transparency=.35+.65*smooth(t,1.2,1.5)end
  elseif not skyGone then
   skyGone=true
   for _,s in ipairs(streaks)do s.Transparency=1 end
   for _,cl in ipairs(clouds)do cl.Transparency=1 end
  end
  -- landing nest pops up on impact, sinks away once the avatar hops out
  local grow=span(t,T_IMPACT,T_IMPACT+.26)
  local nk=(1+2.7*(grow-1)^3+1.7*(grow-1)^2)*(1-smooth(t,3.98,4.28))
  if t<T_IMPACT then nk=0 end
  if math.abs(nk-lastNest)>.004 then
   lastNest=nk
   for _,n in ipairs(nest)do
    local k=math.max(nk,.001)
    n.p.Size=n.size*k;n.p.CFrame=CFrame.new(W(n.pos-V(0,(1-k)*.3,0)))*G.Rotation
   end
  end
  -- mound slumps when the shovel comes out, then melts away before the handoff
  local mk_=(1-.42*smooth(t,T_POP,T_POP+.15))*(1-smooth(t,7,7.6))
  if math.abs(mk_-lastMound)>.004 then
   lastMound=mk_
   for _,m in ipairs(mound)do
    local k=math.max(mk_,.001)
    m.p.Size=V(m.size.X,m.size.Y*k,m.size.Z);m.p.CFrame=CFrame.new(W(m.pos-V(0,(1-k)*m.size.Y*.5,0)))*G.Rotation
   end
  end
  -- landing powder: a short soft puff that covers the avatar for a moment
  for i,s in ipairs(puffs)do
   local age=(t-T_IMPACT-(i%3)*.035)/.95
   if age>=0 and age<1 then
    local a=(i-1)*math.pi*2/#puffs+.4;local front=i<=3
    local dir=front and V(math.cos(a)*.55,0,math.abs(math.sin(a))*.9+.6) or V(math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a)*.7)
    local pos=LAND+V(0,.5,.3)+dir*((front and .6 or .8)+3*age^.6)+V(0,.3+1.7*age-.8*age*age,0)
    show(s,W(pos),(front and 4.4 or 3.2)+age*(front and 4.4 or 3),.85*math.sin(math.pi*age)^.6,i*43+age*30)
   else hide(s)end
  end
  for i,s in ipairs(flakes)do   -- a few soft flakes drifting through the whole scene
   show(s,W(V(((i*13.37)%26)-12+math.sin(t+i)*.2,11-((t*.7+i*2.93)%13),((i*7.13)%20)-6)),.3,.55,t*12+i*37)
  end
  for k,ev in ipairs(GLINTS)do
   local s=glints[(k-1)%#glints+1];local age=(t-ev[1])/ev[2]
   if age>=0 and age<1 then
    local sn=math.sin(math.pi*age)
    show(s,W(scf*(ev[3]*sc)),ev[4]*4.5*(.5+.5*sn),sn^1.5,30*age)
   elseif t<ev[1] or t>ev[1]+ev[2] then hide(s)end
  end
  for i,sp in ipairs(spray)do
   local s=i<=6 and spray1[i] or spray2[i-6]
   local age=t-sp.ts
   if age>=0 and age<.85 then
    show(s,W(sp.p+V(sp.vx*age,sp.vy*age-3.6*age*age,sp.vz*age)),sp.size*(1+.4*age),.8*(1-age/.85)^.8,i*57+age*90)
   else hide(s)end
  end
  for i,ev in ipairs(MOUND_PUFFS)do
   local s=moundPuffs[i];local age=(t-ev[1])/ev[2]
   if age>=0 and age<1 then
    show(s,W(SHOVEL_AT+ev[3]*(1+age*.6)+V(0,age*.9,0)),1.6+age*2.4,.6*math.sin(math.pi*age),i*70+age*20)
   else hide(s)end
  end
  -- camera
  local pos,tg,fov,roll=shot(t)
  pos+=shake(t)
  pos=V(pos.X,math.max(pos.Y,.5),pos.Z)
  return G*CFrame.lookAt(pos,tg)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,roll or 0),fov,W(tg),stats
 end
 return {render=render}
end
